Choose portrait OR landscape A4 proportions for the clearest readable composition; keep the whole document on one image. It is the flat print-ready designed document, not a photograph of a poster. Match the validated warm realistic painted graphic-novel style, natural textures, soft fine contours, cream/terracotta/teal palette; no 3D, stock-photo collage or childish clipart. Absolutely no highlighter strokes, fluorescent marker backgrounds, underlining, answer arrows, circled facts, answer callouts, or selective emphasis on answer-bearing words/numbers/hours. Body typography must be uniform. Private question-answer facts are a completeness checklist, never a printed answer list. Money is exclusively CHF, no euros. Je vous confirme votre réservation pour un week-end de deux nuits à Val-d’Or, un petit village de montagne. Vous dormez dans un chalet près de la forêt.

N’hésitez pas à me contacter pour plus de renseignements.
Cordialement,
Camille Favre
